rationale: S-0016-03 proposes experimentally testing NMDA-spike contribution to DSGC direction selectivity via compartmental simulation. t0054 (minimal_dsgc_ampa_nmda_scalar_gaba) ran a four-value gNMDA sweep on the from-scratch minimal architecture, reporting that voltage-independent NMDA dramatically closes the peak-rate gap (0.667 -> 8.0 Hz) but collapses DSI (0.746 -> 0.082 -> 0.029 -> 0.017). t0055 (in flight) is testing whether voltage-dependent Mg-block NMDA recovers DSI. Together these two tasks cover the NMDA-spike contribution test end-to-end. Rejecting as covered.
